meta.title: Extending a technical round moves its evaluation window and keeps its length
gaps: The available tokens cannot express extending the technical round to exactly T + 1 day; the closest supported value is {{rfpEnd+60}}.
The available read-back fields and assertion operations cannot verify that the evaluation window starts at the new bidding end, ends exactly two days later, or retains a two-day duration.
The available vocabulary cannot verify that every active, pending, or requested technical response receives the new closing time.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer moves the technical round's bid end time with the increase auction time set to “{{rfpEnd+60}}”.

As the buyer, read the technical round and check that Schema check: “ending at” is present; Schema check: “extra closing time” is present; Schema check: “extra closing time” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “ending at” is present; Schema check: “extra closing time” is present; Schema check: “extra closing time” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
